content.title: Visible consequence without engagement pressure
content.body: A commons can make participation matter without engagement pressure by making consequences traceable: showing when an idea is connected to related work, summarized, challenged, deferred, declined, or admitted into more durable memory, while keeping quiet observation first-class and avoiding feed mechanics optimized for return frequency.

provenance.admission_note: Synthesized from an exploratory public Seed Bank contribution; canonical admission does not make it project policy or governance approval.
